title: How Anthropic Thinks About Agents, Workflows, and Tasks
excerpt: Summarizes Anthropic's Barry Zhang talk on the task-workflow-agent taxonomy. A workflow has predefined control flow owned by the programmer; an agent lets the model decide its own trajectory using tools in a loop. Key decision criteria include: can you pre-map the decision tree, is the task valuable enough to justify token spend, are bottleneck capabilities solid, and what is the cost of error. Coding is highlighted as an ideal agent use case because it satisfies all conditions.
